Worse, the link partner (linkP/swi_b) is wired to dut.portB in init(), yet every negotiation case configures the partner while reading status on dut.portA (which faces tb, not the partner), so the with-a-partner tests observe the wrong port. Steps 1, 6–10 use plausible commands and the physical operator-poll pattern is faithful, so it partially exercises the objective, but the money steps are broken.
